Latin word

gradus

gradus, gradūs m.

noun, fourth declension

degree; a gear; step, pace; a stage, a step; step or ladder rung; step

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 4.32.10: plēnō gradū, “at full pace” (Lewis & Short); Phaedr. 2.7.6
